newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia sells Dutch packaging unit.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia sells Dutch packaging unit.

text.p: Food group Nutricia NV said on Friday it had sold its packagings subsidiary LYEMPF in the northern Dutch province of Friesland to the unit's logistics manager Jeroen de Quay.
Included in the transaction, of which no financial details were disclosed, is a small marketing unit which sells ice-cream mix to restaurants and other large users.

De Quay told Reuters by telephone the activities taken over generated annual turnover of "between 10 and 20 million" guilders. The unit employed about 40 people and was profitable, he added, declining to elaborate.
The packagings firm will be renamed LYPACK. It will continue to produce for Nutricia in the coming years but will also try to get other customers.

Nutricia said in September last year it intended to scale down the LYEMPF activities because it used less tin packaging and because of an over-capacity in this sector after its takeover of Germany's Milupa AG in 1995.
